tool.name: ExportProSymbols

param.name: in_style
param.dialogReference: An ArcGIS Pro style file (.stylx), for example a style you created or your Favorites style. It is opened read only and never changed. System styles that ship with ArcGIS Pro cannot be read; save the symbols you want into your own style first.

param.name: scope
param.expression: All point symbols | Selected categories | Selected symbols
param.dialogReference:
• All point symbols: every point symbol in the style. This is the default.

  • Selected categories: the point symbols in the categories you pick in Categories.

  • Selected symbols: only the symbols you pick in Symbols.

param.name: categories
param.dialogReference: The style categories to export. The list is filled from the style. Required when Export is Selected categories; when Export is Selected symbols it narrows the Symbols list.

param.name: symbols
param.dialogReference: The symbols to export, shown as Name (Category) because the same name can appear in more than one category. The list is filled from the style and the chosen categories. Required when Export is Selected symbols.

param.name: out_folder
param.dialogReference: The folder that receives one subfolder per category with one file per symbol. Files with the same names are replaced.

param.name: out_format
param.dialogReference:
• SVG: a scalable vector file.

  • PNG: a square image with a transparent background, PNG Size pixels wide.

  • SVG and PNG: both. This is the default.

param.name: png_size
param.dialogReference: The width and height of each PNG, from 16 to 1024 pixels. The default is 256. Available when Output Format includes PNG.

param.name: out_location
param.dialogReference: The output folder the tool wrote to, so the result can feed another tool or a model. The messages list the number of files written.

tool.summary: Exports the point symbols of an ArcGIS Pro style (.stylx) to SVG and PNG files, one file per symbol in a subfolder per category: all point symbols, the symbols in selected categories, or selected symbols.
tool.usage:
• The Categories and Symbols lists are filled from the style you choose, and the Symbols list follows the categories you pick.

  • Vector marker layers are drawn: polygons, lines, Bezier curves and arcs with solid fills and strokes. Picture markers with an embedded image are placed as images. Font glyph (character) markers, 3D models, hatch or gradient fills and geometric effects are skipped with a warning.

  • The style is read only; the tool never changes it.

dataIdInfo.idPurp: Export point symbols from an ArcGIS Pro style to SVG and PNG icons.
